items.title: Norway contributes to Nepal flood relief through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism

items.title: Brother searches for missing family after Rasuwa flood, still hopes they are alive
items.summary: Rolpa, September 8 Four members of a family from Rolpa have been missing since the Bhotekoshi River flood in Rasuwa. items.title: WorldLink Communications Limited provides Rs 10.1 million for flood victims
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 8 WorldLink Communications Limited has provided Rs 10.1 million in aid for those affected by the Bhotekoshi flash floods on August 26. The internet service provider has deposited the amount into the Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund. items.title: Prisoners contribute relief supplies to Bhotekoshi flood victims
items.summary: Chitwan, September 8 Prisoners at the local correctional facility have provided assistance to families affected by the Bhotekoshi floods. The inmates raised money and contributed their labour to prepare relief materials, which they handed over to Chief District Officer Ganesh Aryal at the prison premises on Monday.
